race.comment: DEEP PLEASURE (2) put it all together in great style last start when leading pillar-to-post for a dominant win. Expect Lloyd to push forward again from the low draw and prove very tough to run down. PIERATA'S GEM (6) is yet to strike through this prep but is knocking on the door. Strips rock-hard fit and should get a lovely trail in behind them from the good draw for Berry. KOOLIBAH (3) is a lightly raced 5YO mare resuming for the Waller camp. Has been fitted with two very quiet trials in readiness, but JMac's booking signals intent. WAKU WAKU (8) is going better than her form reads and if they overdo it in front she might be able to cause a late scare at a big quote.
